title: Uncertainty-Aware and Explainable Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Skin Lesion Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.11280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to high intra-class variability, inter-class similarity, class imbalance, and the limited interpretability of deep learning models. This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware and explainable deep learning framework for multi-class skin lesion classification. The framework combines a vision transformer model (MaxViT-Tiny) with CNN-based models (ConvNeXt-Tiny and EfficientNetV2-B0) through deep ensemble learning. Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout estimates predictive uncertainty and identifies unreliable predictions, while Grad-CAM++, an explainable AI (XAI) technique, provides visual explanations by highlighting lesion regions that influence model decisions. translated_title: 面向多类皮肤病变分类的不确定性感知与可解释集成深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 基于皮肤镜图像的皮肤癌诊断仍面临挑战，原因包括类内变异性高、类间相似性强、类别不平衡以及深度学习模型的可解释性有限。本文提出了一种用于多类皮肤病变分类的不确定性感知且可解释的深度学习框架。该框架通过深度集成学习将视觉变换器模型（MaxViT-Tiny）与基于CNN的模型（ConvNeXt-Tiny和EfficientNetV2-B0）相结合。蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout用于估计预测不确定性并识别不可靠的预测，而Grad-CAM++作为一种可解释AI（XAI）技术，通过突出影响模型决策的病变区域提供视觉解释。在HAM10000数据集上评估，该框架在不确定性感知过滤（熵<1.0，置信度>=0.7）下实现了96%的准确率和99%的ROC-AUC，宏平均精确率、召回率和F1分数分别为94%、95%和（隐含值）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合视觉变换器与CNN的深度集成学习框架，通过MC Dropout估计不确定性并利用Grad-CAM++提供可解释性，在HAM10000数据集上实现了高精度皮肤病变分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep ensemble framework combining vision transformer and CNNs with MC Dropout for uncertainty estimation and Grad-CAM++ for explainability, achieving high accuracy in skin lesion classification on HAM10000.
